what_differs: WagerTech agreed to add an admin-usable manual push/reprocess on the CMS side (backlog), a Slack connector for queue errors, and to store the Salesforce click record ID for two-way troubleshooting. On 2026-09-01 the CMS still had no reprocess function and Kobi wanted it tested before production. No WAGR ticket tracks these client-side dependencies; WAGR-265 is the Salesforce-side SLC reprocess button only.
suggested_action: Suggestion only: add one client-dependency ticket (owner WagerTech) for CMS-side resend/reprocess and error alerting, with a pre-production test checkpoint, so the go-live readiness review can see it.
